name: The egg changes hands

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

summary: At the port, the egg and the tablets meet the seeker who gathered them. Yeh'kinya's next request leads toward the Sunken Temple and a rite tied to Hakkar's essence. The game presents this as a chain of tasks offered by Yeh'kinya; it does not establish an exact date, nor does it make every step a single witnessed event.
